rows.en: Look! It's a monitor!
I never thought it would go this easily.
Heh heh heh, hahahaha!!
The Weather Dopant!?
The Weather Dopant!?
The Weather Dopant!?
The Weather Dopant!?
The Weather Dopant!?
The Weather Dopant!?
The Weather Dopant!?
The Weather Dopant!?
The Weather Dopant!?
The Weather Dopant!?
Surprised? But the truth is...
Heh heh heh, hahahaha!!
The Dummy Dopant!?
The old man, the Weather Dopant... You were posing as both of them!!
Kamen Rider Skull, the Weather Dopant... So it was you posing as both of them!!
Kamen Rider Skull, the Weather Dopant... You were posing as both of them!?
Kamen Rider Skull, the Weather Dopant... You were posing as both of them!?
Kamen Rider Skull, the Weather Dopant... You bastard, you were posing as both of them!?
Kamen Rider Skull, the Weather Dopant... You were posing as both of them!?
Kamen Rider Skull, the Weather Dopant... You were posing as both of them!?
Kamen Rider Skull, the Weather Dopant... Both of 'em were you all along!!
Kamen Rider Skull, the Weather Dopant... You were the one posing as them!!
Kamen Rider Skull, the Weather Dopant... You were the one posing as them!?
That's right! I can become anything! The power of the Dummy Memory is truly great!
Damn it...!! You dragged the old man's name through the mud...!!
Now then, now that the trick's been revealed, shall we get down to business?
Welcome to my laboratory, heroes.
You did well to make it this far!! I'll give you that much!!
Ikadevil!!
Yapool!!
Yapool!!
And... Yapool, the being from another dimension...
Now then, first, let me show you this.
Kamen Rider 1 will be reborn as the Shocker kaijin he was always meant to be.
As soon as the thawing process is complete, we'll begin his re-modification surgery at once.
Next, take a look at this! Your comrades, the Ultra Warriors!
Right now, we're examining every inch of their bodies.
Once that's done, we'll finally carry out their execution.
How could you...!!
How could you...!!
How could you...!!
How could you...!!
You... How could you...!!
How could you...!!
How could you do something like this...!!
Dammit!! You bastards are some real rotten villains!!
How could you...!!
How could you...!!
You want to save them, don't you? Surely you do...?
Fufufufufu... Then I shall give you a chance!
Liar!! You want to save them, don't you?
Defeat the kaijin and Choju we have prepared, and make your way to them.
I want to test the powers our research has produced. A natural desire for a scientist, no?
It's a trap. We don't need to play along.
Silence! Don't think you have any choice in this! Ikadevil, begin the experiment!!
Mm... Then let us proceed with the first experiment. Bee Woman! You're up!
Fufufufufu...!! My name is Bee Woman, and I have been ordered to wipe you out.
First, we'll have you taste the horror of our research.
We took only the strengths of the kaijin you heroes have beaten so far and fused them into one...
Oh! Don't tell me you're bringing out that one!? The kaijin that's a match even for my Choju!!
Yapool, let us sit back and watch from on high.
Yes, its name is Gebacondor!! Now, prepare yourselves!! Heroes!!
Curses... But next time, I will defeat you for sure...!!
Wait!!
...Damn that Bee Woman! She sure is quick to run.
...All right, everyone. From here on, how about I take the lead and clear the way?
I didn't get captured for nothing, you know? I've got a rough map of this place in my head.
I've marked the exit to the area with the cross on your MAP.
Let's head there together!
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Grrr... They actually defeated Gebacondor!!
What does it matter, Ikadevil? It'd be a bore if they went down that easily.
Now it's my turn to have some fun! Hahahahaha!!
Oh, you made it! I've been waiting for you!
Thanks for all your trouble... From here on, I'll make things easy for you.
{8074} and the others lost consciousness.
A powerful stench of rot stings the nose!

notes.note: #0.33-0.42 are party-leader variants of the same shout; all rendered identically.

Labelled Wing Zero, but the content (oyassan = Skull, his mentor, cf. 0311 #0.52) makes it W (Shotaro); the W-leader branch is consistently mislabelled Wing Zero in 0311/0312. 'Oyassan' rendered 'the old man' (affectionate); not in glossary, no precedent in corpus.

#0.47-0.55 are leader variants: #0.50 uses harsh kisama -> 'You bastard'; #0.53 rough speech (Momotaros-type); #0.54-0.55 drop 'both'. Variants ending in a hard accusing question rendered '!?', the rest '!!'.
W (Shotaro) again despite Wing Zero label. Subject restored: 'You dragged...'.
??? speaker; the next line is Ikadevil, so most likely Ikadevil before appearing on screen. Kept neutral.
#0.63-0.64 leader variants (presumably an Ultra-side leader recognising Yapool).
Ijigenjin = Yapool's epithet, rendered 'the being from another dimension'. Rider 2 continuing from #0.62.
koitsu read as an exclamation at the villains ('You...'), not about a third party.
No speaker recovered; archaic koyatsu suggests Ikadevil (who answers at #0.88) or Yapool. Neutral villain voice.
Answers a choice row (#0.89, not in slice) where the party apparently refuses; 'Liar!!' kept.
Labelled Ankh; source tone is plain rather than rude, kept plain.
Tada ja tsukamaranai = he didn't get caught without gaining something; rendered 'I didn't get captured for nothing'.
Trailing full-width space in source dropped (padding, not a tag).
Labelled Skull (presumably the Dummy Dopant again) right before the party is knocked out. 'Raku ni ikasete yarou' is ambiguous (make it easy for you / send you off painlessly); kept ambiguous.
Narration; leads into story_047 (kaijin corpses on the floor).

report: 80/80 rows. W (Shotaro) lines #0.46/#0.57 mislabelled Wing Zero; 'oyassan' rendered 'the old man' (not in glossary). #0.86 speaker unrecovered (villain). #0.121 fake Skull's ambiguous line kept ambiguous. Ijigenjin (Yapool epithet) rendered 'the being from another dimension'.
